title: evnx placeholder template config
description: The JSON file passed to `evnx sync --template-config`. Describes how .env values are replaced when generating .env.example. Reference: https://www.evnx.dev/guides/reference/sync-configuration

$schema.description: This schema's URL. Accepted and ignored by evnx; it exists for editor tooling.

description.description: A note for whoever reads the file. Accepted and ignored by evnx.

patterns.description: Regular expression to placeholder. Matching is case-insensitive. When more than one pattern matches a key, evnx picks an exact key match first, then the longest pattern, then the first declared — so the order keys appear in this file is significant.

default.description: Placeholder for keys no pattern matches.

allow_actual.description: Keys whose REAL value is written to the template instead of a placeholder. For configuration rather than credentials — APP_NAME, LOG_LEVEL, ENVIRONMENT. evnx refuses the sync, naming the key, if a listed value looks like a credential.

naming_convention.description: NOT READ FROM THIS FILE. Naming policy comes from `--naming-policy` or `[sync] naming_policy` in .evnx.toml. evnx warns if this is set here. Kept in the schema because the published example carries it.
